projects.title: Clockwork
projects.description: Built a time tracking and invoicing platform with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. Implemented secure auth with email/TOTP-based 2FA, rate-limited login, password reset flows, and JWT sessions via NextAuth.js. Developed customisable PDF invoice generation with live preview, dynamic footer, and full branding control. Designed a UK tax year-aware dashboard with analytics, client management, and billable hour tracking.

projects.title: PkgMon
projects.description: System to monitor packages on Debian/Ubuntu-based servers. Package versions are periodically queried against the NVD. Email notification alerts when new CVEs are detected. Allows filtering by package vulnerability status.
